text: What is a Unified Namespace?
reply:
A **Unified Namespace (UNS)** is a single, logical data model that aggregates all plant information—sensor streams, device metadata, historical logs, and analytics—into one consistent hierarchy. Instead of siloed databases or protocols, every source publishes to and reads from the same namespace, using standardized naming conventions (often tag‑based). This enables real‑time data sharing across SCADA, MES, analytics, and maintenance tools, reduces integration effort, and ensures all systems reference the same “single source of truth.” Think of it as a common folder structure for all plant data, accessible via common APIs (e.g., OPC UA, MQTT) so any application can locate and use the data it needs without custom adapters.
